description: This PHP source file defines the UploadFile class, which handles file uploads, including validation, URL generation, duplication, movement, and deletion of uploaded files within the SugarCRM-based project.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: A class responsible for managing file uploads, including validation, URL retrieval, duplication, moving, and deletion.

methods.name: UploadFile
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with the form field name for the upload.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Generates and returns the accessible URL for a stored uploaded file based on stored filename and bean ID.

methods.name: duplicate_file
methods.description: Copies a file from an old ID to a new ID within the upload directory.

methods.name: confirm_upload
methods.description: Validates the uploaded file, ensuring it exists, is within size limits, and the directory is writable; sanitizes the filename.

methods.name: get_stored_file_name
methods.description: Returns the filename stored after upload validation.

methods.name: final_move
methods.description: Moves the uploaded temporary file to its final destination within the upload directory.

methods.name: unlink_file
methods.description: Deletes a specified uploaded file associated with a bean ID.
